on someone from his family to turn the light on or he would sit in the room in the dark. With
Fairfield DD's help our assistive and enabling technology coordinator was able to provide a
great number of low-tech inexpensive solutions to help this young boy out. We installed motion
lights in his closet so that when he goes in and out they simply come on and off. We installed

independence and make meaningful contributions. It is our vision, it's our dream to build a

out every day. We currently support 1,900 people with disabilities in Fairfield County. And if you
were to just think 10 years ago with me, that is an increase of 60%. When I started at the county
board 13 or so years ago, we were in the hundreds. It was 700 or 800 people supported. And then just
10 years ago, 1,180, and now 1,900, nearly 2,000 people. In the next five years, we expect that we

not telling you anything you don't know as city leaders. Fairfield County has been since 2010 and
remains the fifth fastest growing county in the state. And as the county grows and as people come

are our birth to three-year-old services that we offer to some 438 kids across Fairfield County,
